## Checklist (CLAUDE.md §14)

- [ ] Scoped to one module / one concern
- [ ] Module boundary rules respected (no imports of another module's internals)
- [ ] Input validated and permissions checked on the backend
- [ ] User-generated content can be reported and moderated
- [ ] Page description, (i) info tips and first-visit guide added
- [ ] Works at 360 px width; empty, loading and error states present
- [ ] Tests added; `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test` pass
- [ ] Docs, `.env.example`, `CHANGELOG.md` and the roadmap updated
